tokens.name: layout.primary

tokens.name: type.hierarchy
tokens.notes: No owner fonts or exact type values are stored.

tokens.name: color.role
tokens.notes: The role is analytical; preview colors are original study values.
tokens.role: Guidance and storytelling support product choice without burying purchase actions.

tokens.name: interaction.priority
tokens.role: Brand color and texture support the outdoor subject rather than simulate nature decoratively.

tokens.name: media.strategy
tokens.notes: Destination media requires its own rights and art direction.
tokens.role: Outdoor product image paired with exact fit, stock, and technical details. Photography needs an explicit subject, crop, rights basis, and decision role.
